# MASTeR Incubation Foundation (MIF)

> Official StartupTN Recognised Pre-Incubation Centre & Section 8 Non-Profit Technology Business Incubator hosted at M.A.M. College of Engineering and Technology (MAMCET), Siruganur, Tiruchirappalli (Trichy), Tamil Nadu, India.

## Quick Facts
- **Institution**: M.A.M. College of Engineering and Technology (MAMCET), Trichy
- **Recognition**: StartupTN Recognised Pre-Incubation Centre (Government of Tamil Nadu)
- **Legal Entity**: Section 8 Non-Profit Technology Business Incubator
- **Focus Areas**: DeepTech, Internet of Things (IoT), Hardware Prototyping, Autonomous Robotics, CleanTech, AgriTech, Artificial Intelligence
- **Funding Facilitation**: TANSEED 4.0 & 5.0 (up to ₹15 Lakhs), MSME Idea Hackathon (up to ₹15 Lakhs), EDII-TN IVP Vouchers (up to ₹5 Lakhs)
- **Flagship Initiative**: Digital Startup Passport (tamper-evident cryptographic milestone & credential verification)
- **Incubation Manager**: Mr. M. Santhosh Kumar (+91 9361697702 | incubationmanager@mamcet.com)
- **Campus Address**: Trichy-Chennai Trunk Road, NH 45, Siruganur, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu 621105, India
- **GeoCoordinates**: 10.9856° N, 78.7423° E

## Startup Passport Specification
Every officially approved startup receives a unique sequential passport identifier in the format `MASTER-SP-YYYY-NNNN` (e.g. `MASTER-SP-2026-0001`). The passport cryptographically binds the startup's corporate identity, founder details, milestone completions, mentor logs, TANSEED grant disbursements, and patent filings into an indelible digital record with public QR verification.

## Funding & Support Programs
1. **TANSEED Seed Grant Facilitation**: Support for Tamil Nadu Startup Seed Grant Fund up to ₹10–15 Lakhs per venture.
2. **MSME Idea Hackathon**: Direct access to Ministry of MSME funding up to ₹15 Lakhs.
3. **EDII-TN Innovation Voucher Programme**: Access to IVP-A (₹2 Lakhs) for design/feasibility and IVP-B (₹5 Lakhs) for product prototyping.
4. **Makerspace & Prototyping**: Complete PCB prototyping, 3D printing, CNC milling, IoT spectrum analyzers, and testing benches.
